use_case_summary: Enterprise engineering org (5k+ devs) looking to standardize IDE copilot across teams. Primary need: sub-100ms token streaming for line completions, consistent cold-start behavior, and model/version pinning per product team. Heavy emphasis on per-seat unit economics — they want predictable monthly spend per active developer and a plan to reduce per-token cost using caching and quantization. Also need code-search embeddings for cross-repo search and reranking for suggestion relevance.
notes:
Key stakeholders: CTO (Anya Singh), Head of Developer Productivity (Rafael Ortiz), SecOps lead (Marta Chen).

Requirements summary (hand notes):
- Target p95 latency for streaming completions <120ms in NA regions; p99 goal <220ms.
- Concurrent active devs: expected 2.5k peak, 5k licensed seats (concurrency ~50%).
- Cost target: ~USD 25-40 per active seat/month for copilot baseline (excluding embeddings), with staged reductions via caching/quantization.
- Must support per-team model pinning (stable pinned model for infra team; experimental float for product teams).
- Data residency: EU customers require code artifact residency in EU region; company wants ability to pin region per-team.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs + KMS for keys, SOC2 compliance evidence and ISO gap plan.

POC notes:
- POC plan: three profiles: 3B quantized (fast/cheap), 7B mixed-precision (quality), and a 13B fallback for tricky completions. Measure latency, token cost, and dev-reported quality for 2 weeks.
- Key metrics to capture: cache hit rate (per repo prefix), average tokens per completion, streaming latency tail, cost per 1k completions.
- Ask from engineering: provide recommended quantization profile and suggested cache TTLs per repo type.

Quotable from Rafael: "We need something that scales to our org and doesn't bankrupt the company — caching + quantization has to be more than a slide."

Commercial notes:
- Procurement schedule: security review (by SecOps) -> legal -> procurement; expected lead time 8-10 weeks after SOW.
- Requested alternatives: proof of region-resident private deployment vs Dedicated with VPC egress.

Open technical questions:
1) KMS integration model for on-prem keys? (SEC-5179)
2) Default approach to cross-team caching without leaking sensitive prefixes?
3) Cost modelling: how to present per-seat active metric (rolling 30-day active devs)
